actionable_sentences: The GetUserToken API requires a username and password parameter of type string to retrieve the user token.
After obtaining the token, the AddAgenda API requires a token, content, time (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS), and location as required string parameters.
All required parameters must be provided for each API call before execution can succeed.
lifted_nl: The GetUserToken API shall require both a username and a password parameter of type string to successfully retrieve the user token.
The AddAgenda API shall require four string parameters—token, content, time formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, and location—to be provided after obtaining the token.
For every API call, all required parameters must be supplied prior to execution; omitting any required parameter prevents successful execution.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: A valid user token must have been obtained via GetUserToken with non-empty username and password parameters, and the caller must provide token, content, time (format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS), and location as non-empty strings.
operations.Function: add_agenda(token: str, content: str, time: str, location: str) -> str
operations.Postcondition: The API returns a status string ('success' or 'failed'). If success, the agenda item has been added to the user's schedule with the specified content, time, and location.
assumptions: The user has previously called GetUserToken and received a valid token string.
The token is currently valid and not expired.
The time value follows the ISO-like format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
Content and location are non-empty strings.
invariants: All four parameters (token, content, time, location) must be non-empty strings at call time.
Time parameter must match the pattern YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
Content parameter must be a non-empty string.
Location parameter must be a non-empty string.
